title: System 6.0.8
note: The standard System 6.0.8 boot disk for the Mac SE (SE ROM, 4 MB): tools-6.0.8 (os-6.0.8 as Apple's Installer made it, with StuffIt Expander 4.0.2 and Disk Copy 4.2 in Utilities). What the SE boot tests and the web UI's se profile boot. AppleShare is set aside in Disabled Items (no AppleTalk network here, and its INIT reserves the high memory Dark Castle, Beyond Dark Castle and Apache Strike need on the SE).
